title: Memberships
nextBillingDate: Start on the next billing date
alignmentHelp: For an existing household, use its next billing date so the family shares one invoice.
assignmentHelp: Assigning records the billing instructions. A pending membership activates after payment is confirmed.
confirmCancel: Cancel this membership? The commitment date stays on record.
priceHelp: Leave the price blank to keep the current price. Changing the plan takes the new plan's billing interval, and its price unless you enter one.
invalidPrice: Enter a valid price, with no more decimal places than the currency uses.
nothingToChange: Choose a different plan or enter a price.
freezeHelp: The next cycle is skipped. Leave the resume date blank to freeze until staff resume it.
resumeHelp: Choose the next billing date. The skipped cycle will stay skipped.
error: Could not load memberships. Please try again.
noPlans: Add an active plan in the billing catalog first.
